text:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick heads up: artist Lina arriving ~3pm with a medium sculpture (fragile) + a small crate of supplies. She's bringing her elderly neighbor who prefers low-sensory areas. Kiosk sometimes times out. Can someone be ready with manual badge and a comfy seat by the north window? Thanks! :wave:

Sam (Front Desk): Copy. Kiosk currently returning 504 gateway. I can do manual badges. Where should we stash the crate until after check-in?

DeliveryBot: ETA 2:52pm. Packages: 1 crate (fragile), 1 box marked TOOLS. Driver note: leave at desk if recipient onsite.

Kei: I'll meet the courier at 2:50 and bring crate to Storage B (near pantry). I'll tag it and add a "fragile - do not stack" sticker.

Ravi (People Ops): Perfect. Please also reserve the window alcove and add a small sign: "quiet area - thank you". Lina's visitor pass should be PHOTO + Visitor role, one-day access.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# manual badge quickflow
/photo-capture --file /tmp/lina.jpg --camera frontdesk
/python /usr/local/bin/create_visitor_badge.py --name "Lina" --photo /tmp/lina.jpg --role Visitor --expiry "1d"
lp -p badge_printer /tmp/lina_badge.pdf
```
I'll provision guest_wlan token for one day too.

BadgePrinterBot: WARNING - low toner detected at 2:53pm. Proceeding with draft print mode.

Sam (Front Desk): Toner low but printed fine in draft. Badge printed at 2:55. :white_check_mark:

Kei: Courier arrived, signed (Kei). Crate labeled and in Storage B. Left a note on top: "Lina - install parts inside (fragile)".

Lina (Visitor): Hi everyone! I'll be there in about 5 mins. Thanks for holding the crate. My neighbor would prefer the cushioned bench by the window if that's available.

Ravi (People Ops): Bench works. Can someone place an extra blanket and a small side table for her water?

Kei: Put the blanket and table out. Also moved a small lamp to reduce harsh overheads.

Sam (Front Desk): Lina checked in at 2:59pm, ID verified, badge issued. Neighbor seated in window alcove, blanket + water provided. All good.

Lina (Visitor): Thank you all! I left a spare hanging bracket taped inside the crate labeled "hang - north beam" for the install team.

Ravi (People Ops): Noted and added to the install notes. I'll ping facilities to schedule the hang window. Closing thread appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
